sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:267

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:267:1
items.html:
In the world of Beria, and a flaw was added in the holiness of Beria, in AA and Aba, and a correction in the shells of AA and Aba, etc. And opposite this a correction was added in the shells of Beria, also in AVI. Behold, at first he says that a correction was made in AA and Aba of the shell, and in the same breath he concludes that only AVI of the shells alone was corrected. This is puzzling.
And the matter is that before the sin of Adam HaRishon, when BYA were in Atzilut, their screens were in the discernment of “He, His life-force and His organs are one in them.” For Beria was in the discernment of the posterior of YESHSUT, which is phase two, and Yetzira was in the discernment of the posterior of AB, that is, in the screen of ZA, which is phase three, and Assiya was in the discernment of the posterior of Yechida, that is, the discernment of Malchut. And all of them received the light of Ein Sof and the light of Hochma from the discernment of AA and Aba. For even Beria, which was in the screen of phase two and desires the light of Hassadim more, nevertheless had nothing detaining it from ascending to AA and Aba, meaning to the level of AB, for there was in it no force of restriction and screen. However, after the sin, when Beria fell below the Parsa, although it serves now too with that same screen of phase two and has Mochin of SAG, nevertheless the screen within it utterly repels Hochma and AB, that is, because of the force of the Sium in the Parsa; for now it is fit to receive only the light of Hassadim and not the light of AA and Aba, which are the level of AB, and see above, page 1904, the passage beginning “And with.”
And this is what he says: “and a flaw was added in the holiness of Beria, in AA and Aba, and a correction in the shells of AA and Aba,” for only Ima illuminates in Beria, that is, the level of SAG in the screen of phase two, but it cannot receive the light of AA and Aba, which are AB, and therefore there is in Beria no discernment of GAR for AA and Aba, as above. And behold, the shell inherited this lack of the light of AB; for those posterior vessels that AVI had, that is, that the level of SAG had, at the time when Beria was in Atzilut — they used to draw the light of AA and Aba whenever they wished — behold, now, after this level of SAG fell into the discernment of Beria that is below the Parsa, these sparks of AA and Aba fell from it to the AVI of the shell. For from them the AVI of the shell were built. So that in terms of level there is in Beria only the AVI of the shell, meaning the posterior vessels that Beria had when it was in Atzilut, for even then its level was only the level of SAG, called AVI. However, the discernment of the sparks that they received from the loss that was made on account of the fall, behold, they are of the discernment of AA and Aba that illuminated in the level of Beria when it was in Atzilut, which are now lost and are no more. And from these sparks the level of AVI of the shell in Beria was built. And this is what he says, “and opposite this a correction was added in the shell of Beria, also in their AVI, and light was drawn to them from the AVI of holiness,” that is, the light of AA and Aba that the level of AVI in Beria had when it was in the holiness of Atzilut, as explained.
